mission: Position the resonance trio at the wound source and initiate the operation before Veraine's ritual reaches critical mass.
why_now: All parties have converged on the wound source. Torin is already there. Veraine's ritual is building. Delay means the wound opens on Veraine's terms.
conflict: Ben vs. overwhelming scale of the primary wound. Final failed appeal to Torin.
turning_point: Three traditions join hands. Ben lets go of control. The resonance begins — three notes that shouldn't harmonize reaching for a chord.
setting: Veranthos wound source — outer edge of the valley
emotional_trajectory: Solitary action vs. collective trust staged as physical convergence
notes: Torin begins the technique. Veraine's ritual building at the epicenter. Ben calls Sera and Kael: 'Now.' They join hands. Three traditions. Ben lets go of control.
